results.note: Thanksgiving night, 57-yard FG at the buzzer

lastGame.title: Bills 13, Chiefs 10
stats: Tyler Bass: 54-yard FG to tie it 10-10, then a 57-yard game-winner as time expired (28.8% make probability per Next Gen Stats)
James Cook III: 32 carries, 117 yards, 5-yard TD; career-high 108 yards after contact
Josh Allen: 10-of-21, 81 yards, 2 INT (18.3 passer rating, second-lowest of his career); 7 carries for 43 yards
Greg Dortch: 17-yard punt return to the KC 39 with 4 seconds left set up the winning kick
Defense: Patrick Mahomes held to 16-of-29 for 174 yards; Greg Rousseau's 11th sack of the season; Harrison Butker missed from 46

news.h: Bass wins it from 57 at the buzzer
news.b: Tyler Bass hit a 54-yarder to tie the game and a 57-yarder as time expired in rain and wind to beat Kansas City 13-10 in the Bills' first home Thanksgiving game.
The win was Buffalo's seventh straight. Kansas City fell to 8-3 and a game behind Denver in the AFC West.
Josh Allen went 10-of-21 for 81 yards with two interceptions inside the Chiefs' 20. He is the first QB since Ben Roethlisberger in 2008 to win a prime-time game with a passer rating under 20.

news.h: Cook and special teams carry the offense
news.b: James Cook III ran 32 times for 117 yards and the only Bills touchdown, and punter Tommy Doman dropped three punts inside the 20. Next up: at New England on Sunday, Dec. 6 at 4:25 p.m.

source: Recaps from buffalobills.com, NFL.com and AP via NBC (Nov 26 Thanksgiving game); AFC East records via Yahoo Sports (checked Nov 27).
